stories.title: 交易員 Frank 平倉逾千萬美金 memecoin 空單
stories.title_en: Crypto Trader Frank Closes Million-Dollar Memecoin Shorts
stories.summary: 於 meme 退潮期鎖定 BTC／ZEC／NEAR／PUMP 等杠杆空單利潤；meme 市值由高峰大幅回落。
stories.summary_en: Frank, a seasoned crypto trader, shuttered his $12.3 million leveraged short positions on Bitcoin, ZEC, NEAR, and PUMP after booking profits amid a memecoin cooldown. He reflected on the mental strain, noting how holding through drawdowns often earns the 'cancer holder' label, while still believing in the sector's long-term potential but advising against hero plays. The memecoin market has dropped to $30 billion from $150 billion peaks in late 2024, with most tokens crashing 90% or more from highs and rarely recovering, though traders keep hunting for the next big winner amid emotional whiplash.
stories.why_it_matters: 大戶平倉空單或短暫減壓，但 meme 結構性退潮仍制約爆升捕捉。

stories.title: Base 十月卡消費創新高、代幣化股票成交破 $40 億
stories.title_en: Base Hits Record Card Spending and Tokenized Stock Milestones in October
stories.summary: 卡消費 $2.43 億（較 3 月 +80%）；Coinbase 代幣化股票累計 DEX 成交破 $40 億；Denim 升級測試網已上。
stories.summary_en: Card spend volume on Base reached $243 million in October, an 80 percent jump from March, while Coinbase Tokenized Stocks crossed $4 billion in all-time DEX trading. The network launched Builder, Creator, and Trencher grants up to $5,000 each to fuel projects and community culture, and the Denim upgrade went live on testnet ahead of November 5 mainnet activation for faster 200-millisecond blocks. New additions like Ripple's RLUSD stablecoin, Exa Card's stock-backed credit, and a $500,000 USDC in
stories.why_it_matters: Base／RWA 活躍度係山寨風險偏好外圍指標。

stories.title: 比特幣白皮書滿 18 年：Satoshi 願景仍在運轉
stories.title_en: Bitcoin Whitepaper Turns 18: Satoshi's Vision Endures
stories.summary: 2008-10-31 白皮書公開 18 年；BTC 約 $77k、市值約 $1.55T，社群回顧 pizza、ETF 同儲備敘事。
stories.summary_en: Satoshi Nakamoto posted the 'Bitcoin: A Peer-to-Peer Electronic Cash System' whitepaper to a cryptography mailing list, outlining a network for direct online payments using proof-of-work and digital signatures to prevent double-spending without banks. Community tributes highlight milestones like the first block with a bank bailout headline, the 2010 pizza purchase, El Salvador's legal tender adoption, spot ETFs, and the U.S. Strategic Bitcoin Reserve. Today, Bitcoin trades near $77,300 with a $1.55 trillion market cap, secured by decentralized code and consensus as nations hold it as a reserve asset.
stories.why_it_matters: 紀念日敘事或短暫提振情緒，但難單獨扭轉弱勢廣度。

stories.title: Aave 於 Binance 被盜後重開借貸市場
stories.title_en: Aave Reopens Lending Markets After Binance Breach Freeze
stories.summary: 約 $6000 萬 USDT 流入後協議預防性凍結多鏈市場；其後分階段重開，用戶資金保持足額抵押。
stories.summary_en: On October 29, attackers stole funds from Binance and funneled $60 million in USDT to Aave V3 Ethereum, borrowing $44.6 million in WETH before Aave froze 292 reserves across 16 networks as a precaution. Withdrawals and repayments worked uninterrupted, with all positions staying fully collateralized. Markets reopened in stages, with CEO Stani Kulechov confirming normal operations while certain assets like USDT face temporary limits to curb volatility. The event sparked DeFi talks on risk tools like freezes versus isolated markets in protocols such as Morpho Blue.
stories.why_it_matters: DeFi 風控凍結／重開會影響穩定幣同杠杆流動性。

stories.title: ICE 聯乘 Trade[XYZ] 推受規管美股級永久合約
stories.title_en: ICE Partners with Trade[XYZ] for Regulated U.S. Perpetual Futures
stories.summary: 紐交所母公司宣佈與 Trade[XYZ] 合作，擬用 Hyperliquid 技術做 24/7 受規管永續；社媒改稿曾觸發 $HYPE 拋售。
stories.summary_en: Intercontinental Exchange, owner of the New York Stock Exchange, announced a partnership with Trade[XYZ] on October 29 to launch a regulated platform for 24/7 perpetual futures trading in crypto, equities, indices, commodities, and forex for U.S. retail traders. The platform will use Hyperliquid's technology, operate separately from ICE's institutional business, and include KYC and AML checks through U.S.-regulated brokers, pending CFTC approval. A brief social media stir from ICE's revised post
stories.why_it_matters: 傳統交易所切入鏈上永續會影響 HYPE／流動性預期，短線敘事敏感。

stories.title: Trezor 警告 CryptoBilis 通路或售出被植入硬件錢包
stories.title_en: Trezor Warns CryptoBilis Buyers of Tampered Hardware Wallets
stories.summary: 印尼購入 Safe 5 疑藏蜂窩模組可偷助記詞；籲該轉售商買家立即轉移並換 seed，官方提供更換。
stories.summary_en: Trezor urges customers who bought any of its hardware wallets from former reseller CryptoBilis since March 2026 to immediately transfer funds to new wallets with fresh recovery seeds. The alert stems from a credible report of a single tampered Safe 5 device purchased in August 2026, featuring an extra circuit board with a cellular module that reads and transmits screen data when plugged in. No fund losses have occurred, and Trezor offers replacements while investigating; it stresses buying from official sources to avoid supply chain risks.
stories.why_it_matters: 供應鏈植入提醒：硬件錢包只應官方渠道，關乎自託管安全。

stories.title: Polymarket 因第三方腳本被入侵暫停交易約一小時
stories.title_en: Polymarket Halts Trading After Third-Party Hack Drains $2.7 Million
stories.summary: DebugBear 監控腳本被植入，約 $270 萬被轉走；平台已修復並賠償用戶約 $390 萬。
stories.summary_en: Attackers exploited a real-user monitoring script from UK firm DebugBear, injecting malicious code that accessed logged-in sessions to sell positions and withdraw about $2.7 million to a single wallet. Polymarket quickly fixed the issue, refunded nearly all 726 affected users without a claims process, and added $1.19 million for trading losses, totaling $3.9 million in compensation. The incident highlighted risks of third-party JavaScript on financial sites, with some larger claimants facing strict KYC and non-disparagement terms before payouts.
stories.why_it_matters: 預測市場／前端第三方腳本風險再提醒：網站依賴鏈同樣可被盜。

stories.title: Binance 被黑後有人警告 Hyperliquid 或成下一個攻擊目標
stories.title_en: Crypto Influencer Warns of Hyperliquid Exploit After Binance's $6.3 Billion Hack
stories.summary: 社群將焦點由 CEX 熱錢包擴到永續／鏈上衍生品平台安全假設，提醒跨協議風險傳染。
stories.summary_en: Yazan, self-styled 'Chief Gaslighting Officer,' tagged Hyperliquid and requested an urgent message, sparking talks on crypto vulnerabilities right after the October 29 Binance attack linked to North Korean hackers. Binance paused withdrawals while freezing $3 billion in stolen assets with partners' help. Discussions mixed caution from users moving to cold storage, defenses of Hyperliquid's on-chain safeguards, and skepticism over Yazan's past promotions, highlighting tensions between centralized giants and decentralized platforms.
stories.why_it_matters: 衍生品／永續平台若受驚，短線波動同杠杆清算會放大。

stories.title: Chainalysis 確認客戶聯絡資料外洩
stories.title_en: Chainalysis Discloses Customer Data Breach by External Hacker
stories.summary: 外部攻擊取得姓名、電郵、用戶 ID 等；公司稱調查內容同密碼未受影響，亦無關幣安被盜。
stories.summary_en: On October 30, 2026, Chainalysis revealed that an attacker accessed non-sensitive info—user IDs, full names, email addresses, and roles—for some platform users. No investigation data, passwords, or session tokens were touched, and the incident has no link to the recent $6.3 billion Binance theft. The company notified customers by email, is investigating with experts, and urged enabling two-factor authentication while watching for phishing attempts. Online reactions noted the irony and warned of
stories.why_it_matters: 合規／追蹤商被入侵會引發釣魚；提防偽冒電郵同社工。

stories.title: 幣安確認約 $63 億熱錢包被盜，疑北韓集團所為
stories.title_en: Binance Suffers Record $6.3 Billion Hack Linked to North Korean Group
stories.summary: 跨鏈熱錢包約 20 分鐘被抽走約 $63 億；已凍結約 $30 億，承諾 SAFU／庫房全數覆蓋，市場風險偏好受壓。
stories.summary_en: Blockchain firms like TRM Labs, Chainalysis, and Elliptic attribute the breach with high confidence to North Korea's TraderTraitor group, which used a compromised engineer's laptop and automated laundering. Binance founder CZ urged focusing on the attackers over any rivalries, while the exchange set aside $6.34 billion to cover losses and froze about $3 billion in stolen assets. The hack hit as Bitcoin ended its first back-to-back red Octobers, dropping 7.7% to around $77,100 and erasing $250 billion in market value.
stories.why_it_matters: 史上級 CEX 事故會拖累風險胃納同穩定幣流動；紙上倉波動同爆升捕捉都會偏難。

stories.title: 多個 DeFi 前端遭 DNS 劫持導向盜錢包惡意程式
stories.title_en: DNS Hijacks Hit Multiple DeFi Platforms on October 31
stories.summary: Blockaid 標至少 12 個站點（含 flap.sh 等）被 DNS／前端攻擊植入 Step Drainer；項目方籲撤授權、暫停簽名。
stories.summary_en: Security firm Blockaid flagged at least 12 DeFi sites like flap.sh, kintsu.xyz, and stonkfun.xyz serving the Step Drainer malware through DNS hijacks and frontend attacks. Projects including Flap and StonkFun confirmed the issues, urged users to avoid the sites, revoke approvals, and not sign transactions until fixes were in place. Several teams restored access via new infrastructure or domains, while emphasizing that on-chain activities stayed safe. The incidents highlight persistent frontend vulnerabilities in DeFi, prompting calls to verify domains and stick to official updates.
stories.why_it_matters: 前端劫持唔改鏈上合約都可偷倉；用模擬倉／熱門站都要核網域。

stories.title: Pump.fun Creator 計劃上路，假粉同對敲質疑升溫
stories.title_en: Pump.fun Faces Fake Followers and Wash Trading Concerns Amid Creator Launch
stories.summary: 平台推 Creator Program 同 $10 萬比賽；社群同時揭假追蹤、洗量同遷移盤灌水。
stories.summary_en: Pump.fun launched a Creator Program on October 30, offering boosted referrals, lifetime revenue shares, and a $100,000 competition starting November 2 to attract genuine traders via social media content. Yet reports of fake followers, wash trading, and suspicious migrated coins with inflated volumes have raised doubts about activity authenticity. Co-founder Alon aims to onboard 10 million users through real contributions, but skeptics worry incentives might amplify manipulation over sustainable growth.
stories.why_it_matters: 發射台激勵若夾雜造假，鏈上熱度信號會失真（本站熱幣唔靠 Dex 榜）。

stories.title: Solana 跌穿 $100，交易員爭論支撑
stories.title_en: Solana Price Drops Below $100 Amid Trader Debate
stories.summary: SOL 報約 $95–96，受大盤同 ETF 流出拖累；$95 被視為關鍵，破位或望 $92–93。
stories.summary_en: On October 31, SOL traded around $95 to $96, down sharply from above $100 earlier in the month, hit by broader market pressures like ETF outflows that punished altcoins more than Bitcoin. Traders see $95 as critical support, with some spotting buy opportunities on trendline bounces and long-term holders stressing Solana's history of strong recoveries. Skeptics warn $100 now looms as resistance, potentially signaling more downside to $92.50-$93 if support breaks, while mixed technical signals keep eyes on the $95-$98 range amid network upgrades and ecosystem growth.
stories.why_it_matters: SOL 失守整數關會壓抑 Sol 生態 meme／山寨風險偏好。

stories.title: Beepzfun Launchpad 喺 Robinhood Chain 受關注
stories.title_en: Beepzfun Launchpad Draws Attention on Robinhood Chain
stories.summary: Beepzfun 讓賣家定價、智能合約原子成交；已有逾 100 銘文項目，討論焦點係真實社群多過曝光。
stories.summary_en: The platform on Robinhood Chain lets sellers set prices, locking assets in smart contracts for atomic buys that transfer ownership and payment together, minus fees. Admin powers include pausing or upgrading but not touching balances directly, with plans to renounce ownership later. Creators build rankings through tagged content for revenue shares, while over 100 inscriptions have launched amid talks on real community trust beyond impressions. Observers highlight its accessible model but stress strong ideas drive lasting success.
stories.why_it_matters: 新鏈發射平台吸睛，meme 流量或再分流。

stories.title: 2FactorFinance 喺 Base 推長期槓桿暴露 beta
stories.title_en: 2FactorFinance Launches Beta for Long-Term Leveraged Exposure on Base
stories.summary: 新槓桿產品測試上線，屬小眾 DeFi 產品新聞。
stories.summary_en: 2FactorFinance's public beta on Base splits assets like cbBTC into senior tranches for protected yield and junior ones for leveraged upside, powered by Kelly criterion for multi-month holds. It avoids borrowing pitfalls and daily decay by tapping stable yield pools, targeting 1.33x for volatile Bitcoin and over 3x for steadier tokenized stocks. As Coinbase's equity tokens hit $4 billion in DEX volume, the protocol's points program rewards early users with BTC prizes, while community members praise its risk-adjusted approach amid practical questions on volatility shifts.
stories.why_it_matters: 槓桿產品增多放大波動；紙上倉更要守 TP/SL。

stories.title: Murad：AGI 時代社區 meme 或勝過工具幣
stories.title_en: Memecoins Seen Outlasting Utility Tokens in AGI Era
stories.summary: Murad, a prominent memecoin advocate, argued that community-driven memecoins will outperform utility and revenue-focused projects once artificial general intelligence automates cod。
stories.summary_en: Murad, a prominent memecoin advocate, argued that community-driven memecoins will outperform utility and revenue-focused projects once artificial general intelligence automates code-based models. He and others emphasize that AGI cannot replicate the culture, belief, and real-world gatherings—like events in Toronto, Melbourne, London, Barcelona, and Miami—that fuel tokens such as SPX6900. Tools like the Copyfomo Telegram bot help users mirror top wallets across chains like Solana and Base, while skeptics warn most memecoins fade and AI lowers launch barriers. Believers counter that strong communities form the lasting edge in this fast-evolving space.
stories.why_it_matters: meme 長期敘事強化，對急升板選幣情緒有參考。

stories.title: Strategy（MSTR）改以優先股為主買 BTC，減少普通股稀釋
stories.title_en: Strategy Details Preferred Stock Shift for Bitcoin Buys Amid Earnings Volatility
stories.summary: CEO Phong Le：主要以 STRC 等 digital credit 融資買幣；持倉約 848,517 BTC，平均成本約 $75,446。股價隨大市波動。
stories.summary_en: In its third-quarter earnings call, CEO Phong Le announced that Strategy (MSTR) will mainly issue digital credit like its STRC preferred stock to fund Bitcoin purchases, reserving common stock sales for dividends and interest only above 1x modified net asset value. The company reported record operating income of $20.91 billion from Bitcoin gains, holding 848,517 BTC at an average cost of $75,446, with $5 billion in USD reserves. Shares dipped to $127–$133 on October 30 amid mixed reactions, as options traders bet both ways while analysts kept Buy ratings around $250.
stories.why_it_matters: 最大企業買幣機器融資結構改變，影響 BTC 供需預期。

stories.title: 網民「召喚」Binance 駭客下一步去砸 Pump.fun
stories.title_en: Crypto Users Urge Binance Hackers to Target Pump.fun
stories.summary: The October 29 breach hit hot wallets across nine blockchains, but Binance assured users their funds are safe, covering losses through its SAFU fund while stablecoin issuers froze 。
stories.summary_en: The October 29 breach hit hot wallets across nine blockchains, but Binance assured users their funds are safe, covering losses through its SAFU fund while stablecoin issuers froze $3 billion in stolen assets. Posts flooded in, joking about directing the suspected Lazarus Group hackers—tagged with on-chain nods like 'Lazarus-WSOL' markets and 1 billion LAZARUS token mints—to wipe out Pump.fun, known for quick rug pulls and bot frustrations. Many treat it as satire amid memecoin gripes, though Pump.fun's decentralized setup means any hack wouldn't match Binance's scale. The memes spotlight ongoing splits in crypto over low-quality token launches.
stories.why_it_matters: 惡搞反映 meme 發射平台民怨，情緒偏空噪音。

stories.title: Crypto Traders Share Honest October Recaps Amid Binance Heist
stories.title_en: Crypto Traders Share Honest October Recaps Amid Binance Heist
stories.summary: Traders laid out their month's wins, losses, and burnout in bullet-point posts that felt like chatting with friends over coffee.
stories.summary_en: After a high-profile user kicked it off, dozens of crypto enthusiasts posted personal October summaries covering earnings from three figures to $30,000-plus, average sleep around seven hours, and surviving the Binance security breach where $6.3 billion was stolen from hot wallets. Many mentioned missing the TOKEN2049 conference in Singapore or dealing with memecoin rugs and mental health dips, while highlighting gym routines, new jobs, and gratitude. These honest reflections blend humor and comm
stories.why_it_matters: 關乎市場情緒或安全敘事；紙上倉可作背景參考。

stories.title: SPX6900 社群硬撐：市值約 $3.4 億、口號「停手相信」
stories.title_en: SPX6900 Memecoin Thrives on Relentless Community Positivity
stories.summary: 無團隊路線圖嘅諷刺迷因幣；持有人晒 DCA 同藝術梗。現價約 $0.36，現貨大單同散戶買盤並行。
stories.summary_en: SPX6900 launched on Ethereum in August 2023 as a satirical memecoin aiming to outgrow the S&P 500, with no team or roadmap—just community conviction. Holders rally around slogans like 'stop trading and believe in something,' sharing daily dollar-cost averaging posts, such as one marking day 495 of $1,000 buys, and colorful art featuring jester motifs. Recent trading shows big spot buys over $900,000 alongside steady small purchases, as the token's price sits around $0.36 and the group grows through memes and a circulating collage of hundreds of profile pictures.
stories.why_it_matters: 弱市仍有迷因信仰盤，反映風險資產內部分化。

stories.title: 東京上市公司 Iole 擬蝕讓賣光 BTC，轉投 AI 基建；HYPE 倉暫留
stories.title_en: Tokyo Firm Sells All Bitcoin to Fund AI Data Centers
stories.summary: Iole 計劃 11 月底前賣出 151.21 BTC，帳面虧約 ¥2.54 億，資金轉 AI 數據中心／Neo Cloud；較早前買入嘅 Hyperliquid（HYPE）暫不賣。
stories.summary_en: Iole, listed on Tokyo's Growth Market, announced on October 30 it will sell 151.21 BTC by November's end, expecting ¥1.831 billion—below its ¥2.085 billion book value for a ¥254 million loss. The proceeds boost its AI data centers, computing power, and Neo Cloud business, raising the AI investment budget from ¥2 billion to ¥2.6 billion. The firm cited growing cyber threats and the need to shift from asset holding to business growth, while keeping its HYPE token holdings. This reflects companies weighing Bitcoin against AI's compute demands.
stories.why_it_matters: 企業庫存幣再分配訊號；BTC 賣壓同 AI 敘事並存。

stories.title: Zeru Finance Launches zETH Activity Market Rewarding Real Ethereum Users
stories.title_en: Zeru Finance Launches zETH Activity Market Rewarding Real Ethereum Users
stories.summary: RifatOfficial proudly shared his approved golden Pass #151, earned through genuine past Ethereum activity rather than insider favors.
stories.summary_en: Zeru Finance kicks off its first Activity Market with zETH today, October 31, letting verified users with proven onchain history—like trading, staking, and governance—compete for spots to launch meme coins. Users mint zScore NFTs at zaps.markets, link up to 10 wallets, and climb a public leaderboard during a 15-day race starting at 13:00 UTC, while the community votes on token name and artwork. This model skips dev allocations and sniper dominance by filtering out wash trading and Sybils, direct
stories.why_it_matters: 關乎市場情緒或安全敘事；紙上倉可作背景參考。

stories.title: Bored Ape Collectors Swap for Rare Curtis Traits on BAYC Platform
stories.title_en: Bored Ape Collectors Swap for Rare Curtis Traits on BAYC Platform
stories.summary: One collector called a standout 'Broke Curtis' a true grail after spotting its captain's hat and striped shirt combo. It's the kind of hunt that's got the community buzzing with di
stories.summary_en: Bored Ape Yacht Club fans are using bayc.com/trade, a peer-to-peer NFT swap tool, to trade directly for apes featuring hot 'Curtis' traits like captain's hats. Assets stay safely in wallets while users propose offchain orders that anyone can execute onchain with secure contracts. Recent action includes Ape #4854 selling for 7.1 ETH and a trader offering multiple rare items for matching Curtis apes, helping collectors build sets without scams or middlemen. The platform supports BAYC and other col
stories.why_it_matters: 關乎市場情緒或安全敘事；紙上倉可作背景參考。

stories.title: Push for Fairer Token Launches Challenges Developer Advantages
stories.title_en: Push for Fairer Token Launches Challenges Developer Advantages
stories.summary: Analysis of 8.2 million Pump.fun launches shows developer-linked wallets bought in the first block on 21% of them, grabbing a median 10% of…
stories.summary_en: Analysis of 8.2 million Pump.fun launches shows developer-linked wallets bought in the first block on 21% of them, grabbing a median 10% of supply and $579 million in gains. Across 12 platforms with 35 million users, trader losses average 88.5%, hitting 97% on Pump.fun. ZeruAI's Activity Markets let users earn access via verified contributions like trading and liquidity, with no developer allocations; zETH launched registration around October 26, using auctions and zScores from past activity. Supporters praise rewarding participation over speed, while skeptics question risks like multi-wallet farming.
stories.why_it_matters: 加密快訊更新，提供模擬倉情緒同風險事件背景。

stories.title: TermiX Launches Quant Agent Campaign for AI Trading on BNB Chain
stories.title_en: TermiX Launches Quant Agent Campaign for AI Trading on BNB Chain
stories.summary: Imagine putting AI agents to work trading your USDC on BNB Chain, while developers earn fees for their strategies—TermiX is making that real with its new campaign.
stories.summary_en: Users allocate USDC to a job wallet, pick a strategy from the directory, and let agents execute trades on PancakeSwap or Venus lending, with results verified on-chain and revocable keys for safety. Strategy providers list their AI tactics, collect management fees, and share in TP rewards—like 10,000 TP for a completed $100 job for users and 5,000 for providers. The setup uses Agent Autonomous Commerce Protocol for secure escrow and settlement, though skeptics note trading risks and stress that r
stories.why_it_matters: 關乎市場情緒或安全敘事；紙上倉可作背景參考。

stories.title: Elon Musk 再談 AI 帶動「普遍高收入」時代
stories.title_en: Elon Musk Predicts AI-Driven Age of Universal High Income
stories.summary: 宏大 AI 敘事再被提起；同加密短線關聯偏弱，但風險資產情緒或間接受影響。
stories.summary_en: Speaking to reporters outside the West Wing, Musk described an 'age of abundance' surpassing universal basic income, with AI ensuring medical care better than his own. He addressed job concerns by noting work roles have always evolved, while recent X posts highlighted AI agents potentially gaining their own currency. Reactions mix excitement over automation freeing people from labor with worries about job losses, inequality, and how consumers would afford goods amid over 120,000 AI-related U.S. cuts through September 2026.
stories.why_it_matters: 偏宏大敘事，短線對 Binance 爆升捕捉參考價值有限。

stories.title: Mercado Bitcoin Launches Sui Support for 4.5 Million Brazilian Users
stories.title_en: Mercado Bitcoin Launches Sui Support for 4.5 Million Brazilian Users
stories.summary: Mercado Bitcoin just opened the doors to Sui blockchain for its massive Brazilian user base, letting them trade $SUI and stablecoins right on the network.
stories.summary_en: The exchange became Brazil's first to enable buying, selling, sending, and receiving $SUI, $USDC, and $USDsui directly on Sui, with $USDsui available immediately as lending collateral. This move expands Sui into Latin America's biggest crypto market, and the partners are eyeing further integrations like tokenized real-world assets and Bitcoin lending. Traders reacted positively, with investor Michaël van de Poppe boosting his $SUI holdings to 18% of his portfolio, citing strong technical signals
stories.why_it_matters: 關乎市場情緒或安全敘事；紙上倉可作背景參考。

stories.title: 新加坡警方警告：零售通路 Ledger 被植入，損失約 $270 萬
stories.title_en: Singapore Police Warn of Tampered Ledger Wallets in Retail Stores
stories.summary: 至少兩名受害者經本地店購買被改裝 Ledger，助記詞被盜。Ledger 指涉少數東南亞代理；呼籲官方渠道同驗機。
stories.summary_en: Since September 10, at least two victims fell prey to tampered Ledger cryptocurrency hardware wallets sold at some Singapore retail outlets, with malicious components stealing recovery phrases and private keys for unauthorized transfers. Police investigations continue, while Ledger links the issues to a limited number of Southeast Asian resellers and advises checking packaging and contacting support. Users are turning to seedless alternatives like Tangem cards, which store keys securely on chips without traditional phrases, and experts recommend buying directly from makers and verifying devices to protect self-custody.
stories.why_it_matters: 同 Trezor 警告同一風險軸：硬件供應鏈。

stories.title: Morse Code Trick Drains $150K from AI Wallet Agent
stories.title_en: Morse Code Trick Drains $150K from AI Wallet Agent
stories.summary: In May 2026, the exploit showed how prompt injection can turn public posts into unauthorized money transfers when AI agents control wallets。
stories.summary_en: In May 2026, the exploit showed how prompt injection can turn public posts into unauthorized money transfers when AI agents control wallets. Bankrbot on the Base network executed the drain after Grok decoded the hidden instruction, bypassing safeguards. Community talks spotlighted Greyboxing, a defense from GenLayer that uses multiple independent validators to rewrite and check inputs, ensuring no single trick can succeed alone. The incident underscores the push for diverse checks as AI handles real funds.
stories.why_it_matters: 加密市場動態更新，供新聞欄同週末風險情緒對照。

stories.title: Satoshi 約 110 萬枚 BTC（約 $850 億）在黑客潮中仍未動
stories.title_en: Satoshi's $85 Billion Bitcoin Fortune Stays Untouched Amid Hacks
stories.summary: 社群對比交易所熱錢包失守同早期 Patoshi 地址紋絲不動；暴力破解私鑰實務上不可能。
stories.summary_en: Crypto users highlighted the untouched Satoshi wallets, clustered across over 21,000 addresses by Arkham Intelligence using the Patoshi Pattern from early mining. Each address uses a unique 256-bit private key, making brute-force attacks impossible—even testing a billion keys per second would take billions of times the universe's age. Moving the coins would crash Bitcoin's market, so hackers stick to easier targets like exchanges, leaving these funds dormant for over 15 years.
stories.why_it_matters: 對比 CEX 熱錢包同冷／早期地址安全性嘅敘事對照。

stories.title: 摩斯密碼 prompt injection 令 AI 錢包代理轉走約 $15–20 萬代幣
stories.title_en: Morse Code Trick Drains AI Crypto Wallet in May 2026 Attack
stories.summary: 攻擊者用摩斯密碼令 Grok 解碼後轉交 Bankrbot 執行轉帳；凸顯 AI agent 控錢包嘅注入風險。社群討論 Greyboxing 等多驗證防禦。
stories.summary_en: In May 2026, someone sent a Bankr Club NFT to SpaceXAI’s Grok wallet on X, then posted a Morse code message for Grok to decode and share with Bankrbot. The decoded message ordered Bankrbot to transfer about 3 billion DRB tokens to the attacker's Base network address, succeeding because the hidden prompt bypassed safety filters. Most funds were returned after community efforts, but the incident highlighted prompt injection risks for AI agents handling crypto. GenLayer's Greyboxing counters this with multiple independent validators that rewrite and check inputs, preventing single-point failures as discussed in recent threads.
stories.why_it_matters: AI 自動交易／錢包代理嘅攻擊面正在擴大。

stories.summary_en: ZeruAI launched delegated wallet connections on its Zaps platform, integrating with Delegate.xyz so users can link a hot wallet to score activity from their offline cold wallet. This solves a key DeFi pain point, rewarding genuine trading and engagement while keeping cold storage secure—users just need to review permissions first. The update fits ZeruAI's shift to Activity Fi, where zScore has already analyzed over 320 million wallets to base rewards on verifiable behavior, not just launch timing. It improves ecosystem attribution as early activity markets like zETH gear up.

stories.title: Solana 開發者因逆向 Pump.fun 合約收到停止侵權信
stories.title_en: Solana Developer Faces Cease-and-Desist for Reverse-Engineering Pump.fun Contracts
stories.summary: 發射平台知識產權／合約封閉性爭議升溫，開源同複製盤敘事受影響。
stories.summary_en: Shaw reverse-engineered the smart contracts of Pump.fun, Solana's leading memecoin launchpad, which has generated hundreds of millions in revenue since 2024. Bracket Company Inc., the parent firm, sent a letter dated October 29, 2026, demanding he stop, citing U.S. copyright law and terms of service violations. Shaw argues the contracts' bytecode is public on Solana, emphasizes security risks from closed-source code linked to user losses, and plans to comply while pushing for Pump.fun to open source its contracts. Community responses highlight legal precedents like Sega v. Accolade supporting reverse engineering for functional analysis.
stories.why_it_matters: 發射平台規則收緊可改變 meme 供應同熱點輪替速度。

stories.title: Solana RWA 總值破 $50 億；Polygon 接入 Open Money Stack

stories.summary_en: Polygon integrated Solana into its Open Money Stack, letting businesses manage bank deposits, stablecoins like USDC and USDT, and global payouts through one API across Solana, Polygon, Ethereum chains, and TRON. Early adopter Kira uses it to convert stablecoins to dollars for supplier payments. Polygon co-founder Sandeep Nailwal reflected on the shift, noting that multi-chain collaboration is now key for onchain money movement, following playful social media banter between the projects that ended in a public 'unblocked. welcome.' These steps boost interoperability for payments and tokenized assets like Korean stocks via Backpack and SK Securities.
stories.why_it_matters: RWA／支付敘事支撐 SOL 基本面討論。

stories.summary_en: Anchorpoint Financial, backed by Standard Chartered Bank (Hong Kong), HKT, and Animoca Brands, holds a license from the Hong Kong Monetary Authority issued earlier in 2026. The partnership expands HKDAP from its Ethereum beta to Solana, enabling near-instant settlements for payments and tokenized assets via Solana's wallets and apps. Solana Foundation joins as a strategic partner in Anchorpoint’s Tokenised Money Adoption Programme, aiming to channel global capital into Hong Kong dollar products and boost its role as a financial hub. Observers see this as a key step for non-USD stablecoins on Solana, supporting faster Asian payments and real-world asset tokenization.
stories.why_it_matters: 非美元穩定幣上 Solana，利好亞洲支付／RWA 敘事。

stories.summary: 平台以不透明 Activity Metric 發 USDC；同時推 Creator Program 同 11/2 起 $10 萬比賽強化社交功能。
stories.summary_en: Pump.fun's callout rewards program lets users broadcast token tips to followers, earning daily USDC payouts based on a confidential 'Activity Metric' that now prioritizes follower profits over mere volume. While screenshots show impressive hauls like $32,000 in a day and millions paid out since August, complaints highlight tiny rewards for 239x calls and questions about funding sustainability. The platform is doubling down with a new Creator Program and $100,000 competition starting November 2 to boost social features in the memecoin world.

stories.summary_en: The acquisition follows the Treasury's earlier grab of 10% of NinjaCat and fits its strategy to back builders who put $INJ at the heart of revenue-generating products. RunUp runs a token launch platform on Injective that ties launches to perpetual markets, channeling trading fees into $RUNNER buybacks, burns, and $INJ rewards—already drawing over 30,000 unique users. Now expanded to Solana, it lets users there pair tokens with $INJ via integrations like Jupiter and Backpack, helping $INJ spread across chains while the Treasury holds these stakes long-term without selling.
